correctness.rationale: The entire finite 12-vertex prism admits two edge orbits. Independently enumerated 14 facets/598 augmented faces for a removed rim edge, and 12 facets/562 for a removed rung. Rebuilt full downward-closed complexes and independently computed mod-2 Betti 2 in degree two and zero in other positive degrees. Constructed complete oriented Hasse diagrams with Morse pairing, checked every directed cover and topological acyclicity: 296 rim pairs and 279 rung pairs. Independently recomputed signed integral Morse boundaries exactly: rim d2=[1,1,-1,-1], d3=[0,0,1,-1]^T, rung d2=[0,-1,1]. Both have primitive unit attachments. For rim, cancel one 1/2 pair and one primitive 2/3 pair; for rung, cancel one 1/2 pair. Remaining CW type is S2∨S2 for both. This is an exhaustive finite proof, not extrapolation.
residual_risks: Finite complex proof covers only n=6 and one deleted edge, precisely the asserted domain. Relative CW cancellation uses standard discrete Morse and primitive attaching degree; integral matrices are explicitly checked.
